name: Saint Matthias
history: The disciple chosen by lot to take the place of Judas among the Twelve, after the Ascension and before Pentecost. He had followed Jesus from the baptism of John to the day He was taken up, and so could be a witness to the resurrection. Scripture says nothing more of him. He is the patron of reformed lives.
life: In the first chapter of Acts, Peter stands up among some hundred and twenty disciples and says that one must be chosen to replace Judas, a man who had been with them all the time the Lord Jesus went in and out among them. Two were put forward, Joseph called Barsabbas and Matthias. The apostles prayed, ‘Lord, you know the hearts of all men,’ and cast lots, and the lot fell on Matthias. That is all the New Testament tells us. Later traditions say he preached in Judea and further afield, in Cappadocia or Ethiopia, and died a martyr. Relics said to be his were brought to Trier, where the abbey of Saint Matthias claims the only tomb of an apostle north of the Alps. He was chosen for one task: to be a witness to the resurrection. He took the place left by a betrayal.
prayerTo: Saint Matthias, you were chosen to fill the place of one who betrayed the Lord, and you bore faithful witness to His resurrection. Pray for all who are called to new responsibilities, for those discerning their vocation, and for me, that I may accept whatever task God gives me. Amen.
penance: Pray today for someone who has betrayed or abandoned the faith, and for vocations to the priesthood. Take on a duty someone else has dropped.
meditation: Lord, you know the hearts of all. Matthias was not the obvious choice; God chose him. Are you willing to be chosen for what you did not seek?
